description: This file defines the Connection class for SQLite database integration within Drupal, implementing methods for database connection, query execution, function creation, database attachment, and cleanup.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Implements SQLite-specific database connection handling for Drupal, including function registration, database attachment, cleanup, and query execution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Connection object, attaches database if prefix is provided, and sets prefix.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Creates and opens a new SQLite connection with specified options, registers custom functions and collations.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up attached databases if tables were dropped, detaching and deleting database files if empty.

methods.name: attachDatabase
methods.description: Attaches an additional database to the current connection if not already attached.

methods.name: getAttachedDatabases
methods.description: Returns a list of currently attached databases.

methods.name: sqlFunctionIf
methods.description: Implements the SQL IF() function for SQLite.

methods.name: sqlFunctionGreatest
methods.description: Implements the SQL GREATEST() function for SQLite.

methods.name: sqlFunctionLeast
methods.description: Implements the SQL LEAST() function for SQLite.

methods.name: sqlFunctionConcat
methods.description: Implements the SQL CONCAT() function for SQLite.

methods.name: sqlFunctionConcatWs
methods.description: Implements the SQL CONCAT_WS() function for SQLite.

methods.name: sqlFunctionSubstring
methods.description: Implements the SQL SUBSTRING() function for SQLite.

methods.name: sqlFunctionSubstringIndex
methods.description: Implements the SQL SUBSTRING_INDEX() function for SQLite.

methods.name: sqlFunctionRand
methods.description: Implements the SQL RAND() function for SQLite.

methods.name: sqlFunctionRegexp
methods.description: Implements the REGEXP operator for SQLite.

methods.name: sqlFunctionLikeBinary
methods.description: Provides case-sensitive LIKE operation with UTF-8 support for SQLite.

methods.name: queryRange
methods.description: Executes a query with LIMIT and OFFSET.

methods.name: queryTemporary
methods.description: Creates a temporary table from a query.

methods.name: driver
methods.description: Returns the driver name 'sqlite'.

methods.name: databaseType
methods.description: Returns the database type 'sqlite'.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database directory if writable.

methods.name: mapConditionOperator
methods.description: Maps SQL operators to SQLite-specific operators.

methods.name: prepareStatement
methods.description: Prepares a SQL statement with options, handling errors and deprecations.

methods.name: getFullQualifiedTableName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified table name without database filename.

methods.name: createConnectionOptionsFromUrl
methods.description: Creates connection options from a URL, parsing the database path.

methods.name: createUrlFromConnectionOptions
methods.description: Creates a SQLite connection URL from options.

methods.name: exceptionHandler
methods.description: Returns a new ExceptionHandler instance.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Creates a new Select query object.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Creates a new Insert query object.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates a new Upsert query object.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Creates a new Truncate query object.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the schema object, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: driverTransactionManager
methods.description: Returns a new TransactionManager instance for this connection.
